## Question

Can a disposable fixture containing a lower-level repository KB, a higher-level domain KB, and a
peer KB make the proposed transfer journeys understandable and reviewable? Exercise bottom-up
generalisation, top-down adoption, and horizontal sharing where vocabulary differs. Show source
scope, source owner, provenance, vocabulary/domain mappings, receiving review, rejection, and the
fact that a transfer creates a reviewable local proposal rather than a silent copy.

## Exploration boundary

Use sample Markdown and mocked transcripts only. The prototype must not modify production bundles,
settle the final data model, or imply that any transfer direction is approved for implementation.
